record_scope_reconstruction: Laffa/Al Laffa road crossing between Kassala, Sudan, and Eritrea on the Kassala–Teseney corridor. Reported restriction is Sudanese admission into Eritrea, not Sudan-side entry and not all traffic.

source_checks.finding: Full relevant English report identifies suspension of Sudanese entry through Laffa because of overcrowding. Publication is November 21; canonical November 20 observation is retained without borrowing Gallabat Sunday onset.

Indexed original IOM description identifies Al Laffa as Kassala/Eritrea cross-border point, but direct page retrieval failed 403. Later inflows into Sudan are opposite direction and cannot date restored Sudanese admission to Eritrea. No crossing coordinates recovered.

phase_decisions.phase_applicability: Modal scope: single_site. Single named road crossing, Sudanese entry into Eritrea only, November 20 observation. Hold because no independently validated border-control location was recovered; do not substitute Kassala, Teseney or Laffa village centroid.
unresolved: Source-backed coordinates of the actual Laffa border post remain unresolved.
No onset, lifting or continuous duration established.
